'''Moingi''' is an unclassified [[Bantu language]] on the right bank of the [[Congo River]] opposite the town of [[Basoko]] in the [[Democratic Republic of Congo]]. It is situated among several [[Soko–Kele languages]], and is quite close to a few [[Bwa languages (Bantu)|Bwa languages]], but it is not known if it is particularly closely related to any of them.
